insights.one_liner: Mileway is a Blackstone-backed European owner of last-mile logistics real estate, an IND sponsor whose Amsterdam finance internship mentions visas.

culture.text: Owns and manages urban last-mile logistics warehouses in more than 11 countries.
A team of over 550 professionals across more than twenty offices.

open.text: Mileway B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a finance internship in Amsterdam, doesn't require Dutch and mentions visas.
The internship draws around 48 applicants on LinkedIn.

growth.text: Set up a €10 billion Euro Medium Term Note programme with an inaugural €1.5 billion bond issue.
Signed new Dutch tenants, including E-Freight Forwarding in Amersfoort.

worth_knowing.text: Blackstone upsized Mileway's first bond offering to €1.5 billion.
